summary: Implementation plan for v10.0 microphone hardware collision fixes: (1) OnAudioFocusChangeListener transient loss flag + SpeechRecognizer.cancel() and 500ms debounced AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN restart, (2) synchronous mutex handoff stopping and releasing WakeWordVoiceService AudioRecord before UI dictation starts SpeechRecognizer, and (3) calling SpeechRecognizer.destroy() and releasing the Processing Mutex when turned off or backgrounded.
